cases.subject: preflight

cases.subject: startPass

cases.subject: complete, second form

cases.subject: complete
cases.asserts: One call, no retry; time limit; detail texts

cases.subject: stop
cases.asserts: polite, terminate, kill; reports whether the process ended

cases.subject: betweenPasses
cases.asserts: One of the three outcomes; a failure is continue

cases.subject: endpoint

cases.subject: clean-up
cases.asserts: No file, directory or overlay of the call is left, also after a kill

cases.subject: degradation
cases.asserts: An operation that throws, runs over time or returns an unknown value takes the plainer path

cases.subject: versions
cases.asserts: The version is recorded, or null
